verdict.rationale: A built-in assistant is a fair axis for a SaaS billing dashboard, but the evidence pack never documents an in-product AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The official MCP server lets external AI agents call the Stripe API. That is a developer-facing integration point for outside agents, an adjacent capability rather than a built-in assistant, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
